decision: Two original exports and the installed v0.23 game agree byte-for-byte. Strict helper types pass. Native bashes, waves, plate removal, grafted parry, ally mending, component pulses, interruption and possession execute through the real game. Original code/data remain unchanged.
preAcceptanceCorrections: Rebind the actual local seat and rebuild its index for the controlled ownership test; player is read-only. Test native possession separately because it clears the cast.
Normalize bash/parry/damage-taken bases without overriding socket and plate modifiers. Assert the native parry preserves shield and wounds the attacker, and earned plates are actually removed.
contract: Live bash threshold refresh precedes support and guardBeat callbacks. Timed duration is sampled at entry. Lowering native arts occurs while casting remains active, before bash/shield rereads and clearing. Shared AI hold and warning deadlines retain original tolerances. A component pulse may be offered on the release/death update before cleanup.
host: Shared admission/payment/interruptions, spatial turning and hits, parry/interception/break dispatch, native arts, conduit/support effects, durable identity and presentation remain host operations.
